verdict.rationale: Insomnia (part of Kong's product suite) provides explicit mock server capability from saved examples, OpenAPI specs, or prompts—including auto-generation from URL/OpenAPI/JSON, cloud mock endpoints created 'in a few steps,' and simple endpoint+sample-response setup, letting consumers build against APIs before they exist. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the mock server workflow beyond vendor docs, and details on sharing/publishing mocks to external consumers.
